verses.text: Haxo yik ix lajwiek' oxe' k'uhal chi', ix sb'o'an sb'a ix Ester chi', ix yak'anoch spichul ix yik sreinail. Ixlajwi chi' ix k'och ix t'a jun amak' ay t'a sti' jun yet'tal winh rey chi', b'aj k'ojanem winh t'a sk'ojnub' yik sreyal.
Ayik ix yilanelta winh to ayek' ix t'a stielta chi', ix sch'oxan winh to stzalaj winh yet' ix, ix yak'anelta sk'okoch winh nab'a oro. Ix ochk'och ix, ix och yub'yub' ix t'a snhi' k'e'en k'okoch chi'.
Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a ix icha tik: --¿Tas tzach ik'an reina Ester? ¿Tas tza nib'ej? Tato tza nib'ej tza k'an nanhalok in makb'en tik, syal wak'an t'ayach, xchi winh t'a ix. Ix tak'wi ix icha tik:
--Mamin rey, tato syal a k'o'ol, ay jun niwan wa'el ix wak' b'ochajok to tzach kot wa'el tiknaik yet' winhaj Amán, yujto niwan elk'och t'a yol in sat, xchi ix. Ix yalan winh icha tik:
--Awtejekkot winhaj Amán t'a elanhchamel to sk'anab'ajaj masanil tas snib'ej ix reina Ester tik, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix b'at winh rey yet' winhaj Amán t'a jun niwan wa'el ix sb'o ix Ester chi'.
Ayik wan yuk'an wino heb', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a ix icha tik: --k'an masanil tas tza nib'ej t'ayin, ol wak' t'ayach, wach'chom tza k'an nanhalok in makb'en tik, syal wak'an t'ayach, xchi winh.
Ix yalan ix t'a winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, a wal tas tzin nib'ej tzin k'an t'ayach haton tik:

Tato yel xajan in u'uj, tato b'ekan a k'ol ak'an tas tzin k'ana', schaokab' a k'ol a kotxi wa'el k'ik'an yet' winhaj Amán tik. Ol in chek b'ochaj junokxo wa'el, yujto te niwan elk'och t'a yol in sat. Hato k'ik'an chi' swal t'ayach tas tzin nib'ej, xchi ix.

Ix te tzalaj winhaj Amán ayik ix elta winh b'aj ix och wa'el chi', palta ayik ix yilan winh to ayek' winhaj Mardoqueo t'a sti' spalacio winh rey chi', ix te kot yowal winh yujto ayik ix ek' winh ta', maj k'elaj linhan winhaj Mardoqueo chi', maj empax nhojan winh.
Ha t'a jun rato chi' maj sch'oxel-laj schichonk'olal winh chi'. Haxo yik ix k'och winh t'a spat, ix yawtankot juntzanh heb' yamigo winh, ix yawtanpaxkot ix yetb'eyum winh, haton ix Zeres.

Ix och ijan winh yik'ancha'anh sb'a, ix yalan jantak sb'eyumal winh t'a heb', tzijtum pax yuninal winh. Ix yalanpax winh to ix sik'chajelta winh yuj winh rey t'a skal juntzanhxo heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet'ok, ix ak'chajoch winh yajalilok juntzanh heb' winh chi'.

Ix yalanxi winh icha tik: --Hanhejtona' a innhej ix in awtajb'at wa'el yet' winh rey t'a jun niwan wa'el yuj ix reina Ester. Awtab'il in pax wa'el yet' winh rey chi' k'ik'an t'a junxo niwan wa'el syak' ix t'a winh rey chi'.
Palta ayik swilanoch jun winh israel skuchan Mardoqueo k'ojanem t'a sti' spalacio winh rey chi', masanil juntzanh tas ay t'ayin tik, manhxa jab'ok yelk'och t'a yol in sat, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix yal ix yetb'eyum winh chi' yet' heb' yamigo winh chi' icha tik: --Ak' b'ochajem junok te te' jun ch'anhil tz'ajk'e ste'el. Tza k'anan t'a winh rey chi', haxo k'ik'an k'inhib'al sk'e t'unhan winhaj Mardoqueo chi' t'a te', yik wach' tzalajk'olal tzach b'at t'a jun niwan wa'el yet' winh rey chi', manhxa jab'ok tas tza na'a, xchi heb'. Ha jun pensar chi' ix scha sk'ol winhaj Amán chi', ix schekan winh b'ojok jun te te' chi'.
